summary: Our project is a Space Health Monitoring Dashboard built using Python and Streamlit to address the health challenges astronauts face during space missions. It provides three key monitoring features: Radiation Monitoring, which tracks radiation levels aboard the ISS over time; Muscle and Nerve Health Monitoring, which provides basic health status assessments and tracks recent trends; and Sleep Health Monitoring, which evaluates sleep duration and efficiency through historical data. By combining these features into one interactive dashboard, our solution makes astronaut health data easier to understand and monitor. It aims to improve health awareness, identify potential health concerns early, and support better decision-making to protect astronauts' well-being during space missions.
details:
This project is a health monitoring dashboard built using python and streamlit and hosted with streamlit.

This project includes:

- Radiation levels in the ISS over time, gives radiation dose received and a health status (Nominal, Caution, or Critical Alert)

- Muscle and nerve health monitor, gives a basic status check for muscle and nerve health and recent trends

- Sleep health monitor, checks sleep duration and efficiency with historical trends

The link to the github repository can be found by clicking on the github icon on the top left of the streamlit page.
